scope: AI probabilistic event forecasting; selected adjacent time-series research

sources.title: Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
sources.authors: Tilmann Gneiting; Adrian E. Raftery
sources.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association 102(477):359–378
sources.finding: Establishes proper scoring as a basis for eliciting and evaluating probability distributions.
sources.caveat: Expected-score incentives do not eliminate finite-sample uncertainty.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Define score conventions and retain forecast distributions.

sources.title: Psychological Strategies for Winning a Geopolitical Forecasting Tournament
sources.authors: Barbara Mellers et al.
sources.finding: Probability training, collaboration, and tracking improved human forecasting.
sources.caveat: Human intervention effects require separate validation for AI systems.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Test training guidance, independent estimates, and collaboration.

sources.title: Developing expert political judgment: The impact of training and practice on judgmental accuracy in geopolitical forecasting tournaments
sources.authors: Welton Chang; Eva Chen; Barbara Mellers; Philip Tetlock
sources.finding: Brief CHAMPS KNOW training improved human Brier scores by 6–11%.
sources.caveat: Does not estimate an LLM treatment effect.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Use forecasting principles as testable interventions.

sources.title: ForecastQA: A Question Answering Challenge for Event Forecasting with Temporal Text Data
sources.authors: Woojeong Jin et al.
sources.finding: Introduces 10,392 forecasting questions using time-restricted news.
sources.caveat: Multiple-choice accuracy differs from probabilistic event forecasting; versions report different baseline accuracy.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Keep task type and publication version explicit.

sources.title: Forecasting Future World Events with Neural Networks
sources.authors: Andy Zou et al.
sources.finding: Autocast links tournament questions to dated news; larger models and relevant retrieval improve results.
sources.caveat: A fixed historical test becomes vulnerable as model training windows advance.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Import question, evidence-date, and numeric-target metadata.

sources.title: AutoCast++: Enhancing World Event Prediction with Zero-shot Ranking-based Context Retrieval
sources.authors: Qi Yan; Raihan Seraj; Jiawei He; Lili Meng; Tristan Sylvain
sources.finding: Relevance ranking, recency, and summarization improve retrieval-based event prediction.
sources.caveat: Dataset-specific gains do not establish live generalization.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Separate retrieval selection from probability synthesis.

sources.title: Large Language Model Prediction Capabilities: Evidence from a Real-World Forecasting Tournament
sources.authors: Philipp Schoenegger; Peter S. Park
sources.finding: GPT-4 underperformed the human crowd and was not significantly different from a 50% baseline.
sources.caveat: Applies to the tested early model and protocol.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Preserve a simple prospective baseline.

sources.title: Approaching Human-Level Forecasting with Language Models
sources.authors: Danny Halawi; Fred Zhang; Yueh-Han Chen; Jacob Steinhardt
sources.finding: Retrieval, reasoning, and aggregation approach competitive human-crowd performance.
sources.caveat: Later methodological work identifies residual leakage risks; repeated forecast dates require careful weighting.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Build modular research and aggregation baselines.

sources.title: Wisdom of the Silicon Crowd: LLM Ensemble Prediction Capabilities Rival Human Crowd Accuracy
sources.authors: Philipp Schoenegger; Indre Tuminauskaite; Peter S. Park; Rafael Valdece Sousa Bastos; Philip E. Tetlock
sources.locator: Study 1 and Study 2 abstracts; published DOI 10.1126/sciadv.adp1528
sources.finding: A twelve-model ensemble was not statistically different from a human crowd; combining human and AI predictions was useful.
sources.caveat: Only 31 questions; failure to reject difference is not universal equivalence.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Retain independent member forecasts and a simple aggregate.

sources.title: Superhuman Automated Forecasting
sources.authors: Center for AI Safety; accompanying report by Long Phan et al.
sources.read_depth: Primary announcement; report itself not retrieved
sources.finding: Announces the FiveThirtyNine forecasting system and crowd-level performance claims.
sources.caveat: The announcement relies on cutoff and date-restricted search assumptions subsequently challenged.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Retain as a historically influential claim, not decisive capability evidence.

sources.title: ForecastBench: A Dynamic Benchmark of AI Forecasting Capabilities
sources.authors: Ezra Karger; Houtan Bastani; Yueh-Han Chen; Zachary Jacobs; Danny Halawi; Fred Zhang; Philip E. Tetlock
sources.evaluation_design: Prospective; mixed dataset and market questions
sources.finding: The original human comparison favors superforecasters; evaluation combines multiple horizons and source categories.
sources.caveat: Some unresolved market forecasts use crowd proxies; overall weighting differs from a pooled Brier mean.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Store score target, horizon, and aggregation policy.

sources.title: Consistency Checks for Language Model Forecasters
sources.authors: Daniel Paleka; Abhimanyu Pallavi Sudhir; Alejandro Alvarez; Vineeth Bhat; Adam Shen; Evan Wang; Florian Tramèr
sources.finding: Uses arbitrage on logically related forecasts as an immediate diagnostic and reports correlation with Brier performance.
sources.caveat: Coherence alone cannot establish accurate beliefs.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Add complement, conjunction, conditional, and horizon checks.

sources.title: Pitfalls in Evaluating Language Model Forecasters
sources.authors: Daniel Paleka; Shashwat Goel; Jonas Geiping; Florian Tramèr
sources.finding: Identifies outcome-selection leakage, unreliable historical retrieval, cutoff uncertainty, copied crowd signals, and correlated tournament risk.
sources.caveat: Some examples illustrate possible mechanisms rather than quantify every system's bias.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Maintain multiple temporal controls and explicit comparison conditions.

sources.title: MIRAI: Evaluating LLM Agents for Event Forecasting
sources.authors: Chenchen Ye et al.
sources.evaluation_design: Historical relational prediction with GDELT and news tools
sources.finding: Provides an agent environment combining structured international events and textual evidence.
sources.caveat: Relational prediction metrics are not interchangeable with tournament Brier scores.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Support tools over structured event histories.

sources.title: FOReCAst: The Future Outcome Reasoning and Confidence Assessment Benchmark
sources.authors: Zhangdie Yuan; Zifeng Ding; Andreas Vlachos
sources.finding: Covers Boolean outcomes, timeframes, and quantities with confidence assessment.
sources.caveat: No numerical superiority claim extracted at this reading depth.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Plan schemas beyond binary events.

sources.title: FutureX: An Advanced Live Benchmark for LLM Agents in Future Prediction
sources.authors: Zhiyuan Zeng et al.
sources.finding: Introduces a live, frequently updated benchmark evaluating 25 LLM/agent systems.
sources.caveat: Inspect task-specific scoring and sampling before comparing ranks with other platforms.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Maintain an adapter for prospective evaluation.

sources.title: Bench to the Future: A Pastcasting Benchmark for Forecasting Agents
sources.authors: Jack Wildman; Nikos I. Bosse; Daniel Hnyk; Peter Mühlbacher; Finn Hambly; Jon Evans; Dan Schwarz; Lawrence Phillips
sources.finding: Pairs resolved questions with offline web corpora for repeatable agent evaluation.
sources.caveat: Training-cutoff validity changes with the model; availability is not equivalent to a fully open corpus.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Version frozen evidence and model eligibility.

sources.title: AIA Forecaster: Technical Report
sources.authors: Rohan Alur; Bradly C. Stadie; Daniel Kang et al.
sources.evaluation_design: Retrospective benchmarks plus 64 resolved live markets
sources.finding: Combines search, synthesis, and calibration; reports expert-comparable benchmark scores and complementarity with market forecasts.
sources.caveat: Live evidence is smaller; 1,750 open-market comparisons use market prices rather than resolved outcomes.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Evaluate market-assisted and market-blind modes separately.

sources.title: LLM-as-a-Prophet: Understanding Predictive Intelligence with Prophet Arena
sources.authors: Qingchuan Yang; Simon Mahns; Sida Li; Anri Gu; Jibang Wu; Haifeng Xu
sources.finding: Finds horizon-sensitive model/market comparisons and no significant gain from the tested reasoning scaffold.
sources.caveat: Market-level records share events; gross-return comparisons do not establish net profitability.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Record lead times and test scaffolds behaviorally.

sources.title: Automating Forecasting Question Generation and Resolution for AI Evaluation
sources.authors: Nikos I. Bosse; Peter Mühlbacher; Jack Wildman; Lawrence Phillips; Dan Schwarz
sources.finding: Creates 1,499 questions; a human audit finds four resolution errors in 100 cases.
sources.caveat: A low automated annulment rate is not proof of high resolution quality; §5.3 contains inconsistent counts.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Treat resolution as an auditable process with disputes and corrections.

sources.title: Evaluating Strategic Reasoning in Forecasting Agents
sources.authors: Tom Liptay; Dan Schwarz; Rafael Poyiadzi; Jack Wildman; Nikos I. Bosse
sources.finding: Combined system scores 0.119 versus 0.130 for Opus on a matched subset; rationale and case analyses identify potential reasoning gaps.
sources.caveat: Possible benchmark overfitting; rationale format confounding; research comparison changes supplied evidence.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Test review interventions and preserve evidence-linked intermediate forecasts.

sources.title: Agentic Forecasting using Sequential Bayesian Updating of Linguistic Beliefs
sources.authors: Kevin Murphy
sources.finding: Structured belief updates, aggregation, and calibration improve results; removing belief state costs 5.1 Brier Index points in an ablation.
sources.caveat: Retrospective and mostly one base model; headline cohort differs from expanded ablation cohort; some modes use market priors.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Represent current belief, evidence, and open questions explicitly.

sources.title: Outcome-based Reinforcement Learning to Predict the Future
sources.authors: Benjamin Turtel; Danny Franklin; Kris Skotheim; Luke Hewitt; Philipp Schoenegger
sources.venue: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, November 2025
sources.finding: Forecast-specific RL makes a compact model competitive with larger baselines while improving calibration.
sources.caveat: Synthetic questions and historical outcomes require leakage and generalization audits; versions differ.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Export proper-score training data only after evaluation integrity exists.

sources.title: Future-as-Label: Scalable Supervision from Real-World Outcomes
sources.authors: Benjamin Turtel; Paul Wilczewski; Danny Franklin; Kris Skothiem
sources.finding: Uses temporally masked inputs and realized outcomes for forecasting supervision.
sources.caveat: Masking supplied text cannot remove model memorization or resolution error; an OpenReview version has different model details.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Keep predictor inputs and resolver evidence separate.

sources.title: Reaching the frontier of AI forecasting with reinforcement learning
sources.authors: Scott Jeen; Matthew Aitchison; Maximilian Anthony Hugh Clark; Toby Shevlane; Ben Day
sources.read_depth: Paper abstract/introduction and author publication page
sources.finding: RL on roughly 10,000 questions improves gpt-oss-120b to frontier-comparable performance in the reported test.
sources.caveat: Workshop evidence; full temporal and model-selection audits remain necessary.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Compare training against cheaper calibration and sampling baselines.

sources.title: Diversity is the Strength of the AI Crowd
sources.authors: Matthew Aitchison; Scott Jeen; Toby Shevlane; Ben Day
sources.finding: Model diversity changes marginal ensemble value; individual rank does not determine contribution.
sources.caveat: One tournament, up to three runs per model, and sample counts do not equal monetary cost.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Track residual dependence and validate ensemble selection out of sample.

sources.title: Aligning LLMs with Human Uncertainty: A Beta-Bernoulli Calibrator for LLM Forecasting
sources.authors: Hui Dai; Ryan Teehan; Parsa Torabian; Mengye Ren
sources.evaluation_design: Learned calibration using outcomes and human forecasts
sources.finding: Learns a distribution over event likelihood from initial estimates and human/outcome supervision.
sources.caveat: Depends on the human training signal and domain mix; does not model evidence updates.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Preserve provenance for learned calibration and second-order uncertainty.

sources.title: What LLM Forecasters Know but Don't Say: Probing Internal Representations for Calibration and Faithfulness
sources.authors: Raphaël Sarfati; Pratyush Ranjan Tiwari; Siddharth Boppana; Christopher J. Earls; Srikar Varadaraj; Eric Ho
sources.finding: Probes improve calibration in tested models; evidence interventions can change forecasts without corresponding rationale changes.
sources.caveat: Recent model-specific evidence; activation access is needed for the probing method.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Use input interventions to audit reasoning claims.

sources.title: LLM-based Agents for Forecasting and Prediction: Methods, Training, Evaluation, and Applications
sources.authors: Xiaogang Xu et al.
sources.finding: Maps standalone, tool-augmented, and hybrid forecasting and emphasizes evaluation limitations.
sources.caveat: Secondary synthesis; template journal metadata does not establish journal publication.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Use as a discovery map and verify claims in original papers.

sources.title: Chronos: Learning the Language of Time Series
sources.authors: Abdul Fatir Ansari et al.
sources.venue: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, October 2024
sources.finding: Trains transformer architectures on tokenized numerical series for transferable forecasting.
sources.caveat: A numerical foundation model is distinct from a general text-reasoning agent.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Treat specialist models as forecast providers and comparators.

sources.title: Are Language Models Actually Useful for Time Series Forecasting?
sources.authors: Mingtian Tan; Mike A. Merrill; Vinayak Gupta; Tim Althoff; Thomas Hartvigsen
sources.finding: Removing or simplifying the LLM component often preserves or improves results in tested systems.
sources.caveat: Does not refute all contextual or hybrid forecasting.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Require a component-removal baseline for expensive designs.

sources.title: Probabilistic weather forecasting with machine learning
sources.authors: Ilan Price et al.
sources.finding: Shows strong probabilistic weather performance from a specialized learned model.
sources.caveat: Domain-specific data and targets do not establish general geopolitical skill.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Route suitable questions to specialist distributions.

sources.title: Chronos-2: From Univariate to Universal Forecasting
sources.authors: Abdul Fatir Ansari et al.
sources.finding: Extends pretrained forecasting to related series and covariates.
sources.caveat: Selected adjacent coverage, not an exhaustive time-series comparison.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Allow covariate-aware numerical adapters.

sources.title: Context is Key: A Benchmark for Forecasting with Essential Textual Information
sources.authors: Andrew R. Williams et al.
sources.evaluation_design: Numerical series with essential textual context
sources.finding: Constructs tasks requiring text and numbers together; its prompting baseline outperforms tested alternatives.
sources.caveat: Purpose-built contextual tasks differ from ordinary univariate series.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Test whether text adds information beyond the numeric baseline.

sources.title: Hindcast: Replaying Prediction Markets to Evaluate LLM Forecasters
sources.authors: Xiao Ye; Jacob Dineen; Evan Zhu; Shijie Lu; Kevin Song; Ben Zhou
sources.finding: Tests retrieval with dated social evidence and contemporaneous market baselines; benefit depends on coverage.
sources.caveat: Selection judges evidence against the resolved side, creating an outcome-conditioned sampling concern; archive controls do not certify model training cutoffs.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Record evidence coverage and archive selection effects.

sources.title: Agentic Time Machine as an Infrastructure for Future-Event Forecasting
sources.authors: Jingyi Chai; Bingyang Zheng; Xiangrui Liu; Hao Lu; Zihang Zhou; Tianchen Wang; Kemeng Zhang; Siheng Chen
sources.evaluation_design: Filtered historical web replay plus live comparison
sources.finding: Combines a replay filter with planner/solver/aggregator forecasting and reports alignment with live rankings.
sources.caveat: The 11 correlation points include repeated runs and related ensembles; filtered replay needs independent temporal and selection audits.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Compare replay rankings with prospective performance.

sources.title: AI-Augmented Predictions: LLM Assistants Improve Human Forecasting Accuracy
sources.authors: Philipp Schoenegger; Peter S. Park; Ezra Karger; Sean Trott; Philip E. Tetlock
sources.venue: ACM Transactions on Interactive Intelligent Systems 15(1), Article 4
sources.evaluation_design: Preregistered prospective experiment; 991 participants; six questions
sources.finding: Both frontier-model assistants improve human accuracy relative to a weaker-model control.
sources.caveat: Few questions, outlier sensitivity, and a control differing in both model capability and forecasting support.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Compare assisted forecasts against both human-only and model-only baselines.

sources.title: The Wisdom of Deliberating AI Crowds: Does Deliberation Improve LLM-Based Forecasting?
sources.authors: Paul Schneider; Amalie Schramm
sources.evaluation_design: Historical evaluation; 202 binary questions; four conditions
sources.finding: Diverse models with shared information improve log loss after deliberation; homogeneous groups do not benefit.
sources.caveat: Conditional result across several scenarios; full statistical and temporal audit remains pending.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Distinguish deliberation from averaging and preserve estimates before discussion.

sources.title: The Strategic Foresight of LLMs: Evidence from a Fully Prospective Venture Tournament
sources.authors: Felipe A. Csaszar; Aticus Peterson; Daniel Wilde
sources.finding: Several LLMs outperform the studied human evaluators; ensembles and human–AI teams do not beat the best model.
sources.caveat: Ranking differs from probability accuracy; comparisons share 30 ventures and one domain.
sources.vorhersage_implication: Test collaboration against the strongest constituent and retain event-level sample counts.
